text: Astronomy is the study of the universe, and it can be fascinating and mysterious. One of the most interesting aspects of astronomy is the study of craters, which are formed when meteorites strike the surface of a planet or moon. Craters are often caused by the impact of a meteorite, and can be used to determine the age of a planet or moon. Orbiting the Earth is another important aspect of astronomy, as it allows scientists to study the Earth from above and observe the changes in our planet's atmosphere and weather patterns.
